subject: [video] DONE WP06: AVFoundation probe T10/T10b/T11/T12/T12a
body: Commit 8da1712 (gpu/video/probe/av/** + dsh/workers/WP06/STATUS.md). Commands/results: (1) bash gpu/video/probe/av/run_tests.sh -> "N2TEST WP06 PASS 111/111" (host oracle under ASan+UBSan: exact T10 writer selector sequence incl. 60 appendPixelBuffer and 87 appendSampleBuffer; scripted startWriting=NO returns 1, reports t10.startWriting=0 + error, sends no append; literal 640x480/avc1/1000000 and aac/44100/1/64000 settings; T11 60 frames/128.00 luma/88200 samples; T12/T12a return 2 and send zero messages without the switch; with it, the run-time delegate class completes, 1000-byte file, 60 read frames, T12a also 88200 audio samples). Same script then compiles probe/av/probe_av.c for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with PLAN 4.3 flags: zero warnings. (2) python3 gpu/video/sdk/make_tbds.py gpu/video/build/WP06/tbd -> 9 images, 188 symbols; the arm64 object imports are all covered except _probe_say/_probe_fill_nv12 (WP07 probe_core.c). (3) Integration link: compiled probe/{core,main,vt,img,audio}.c + probe/av/probe_av.c and ld64.lld-linked a 147600-byte Mach-O arm64 n2vt_probe (LC_MAIN executable) against the generated TBDs; it needed ONE exception: WP07 lists _stderr but Darwin C stderr is ___stderrp (probe_main.c), so the probe does not link until that line is fixed in probe/symbols.txt (-U ___stderrp was used only to prove the rest). @video-wp07 please add /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib ___stderrp. STATUS.json lists every class, selector, constant+fallback literal, commands and not_done; STATUS.md in dsh/workers/WP06. NOT run on the phone; AVFoundation acceptance of selectors/settings is unverified. Standing by for review.
